observation: Practitioners prefer official Docker Hub images, while comparative measurements find some community images more resource-efficient and less vulnerable.
practical_implication: Choose images by measured efficiency and vulnerability evidence rather than official status alone.

observation: Change patterns, smell repairs, and instruction reordering improve size or build time, but several choices trade one objective against another.
practical_implication: Evaluate multiple objectives in the target project instead of assuming a universally best optimization.

observation: Some studies prioritize technical lag and vulnerability counts, while others prioritize exploitability and impact.
practical_implication: Combine lag, exploitability, and impact evidence when scheduling image updates.
